name: argus
description: Pressure-tests an important decision and returns a one-screen summary: the recommendation, why, the biggest open risk, the alternative you passed on, and the next concrete action — plus one falsifiable prediction you resolve against reality later (/argus:resolve). Runs an agent review team on your real code, PRs, and files to verify claims before you commit. Installing also wires the argus-decision-mcp server automatically (one install, no separate init).
